test_TextDatasetReader_keep_in_memory: test TextDatasetReader with keep_in_memory parameter to control Arrow memory allocation behavior
test_TextDatasetReader_features: test TextDatasetReader with custom Features specifying string, int32, or float32 dtypes for the text column
test_TextDatasetReader_split: test TextDatasetReader with split parameter supporting None, NamedSplit, string, or test split values
test_TextDatasetReader_path_type: test TextDatasetReader accepting both a single string path and a list of paths
test_TextDatasetReader_datasetdict: test TextDatasetReader with a dict of paths to produce a DatasetDict with multiple named splits
